awards.title: 3rd Place at UTEK 2026 Programming Competition
awards.description: Placed 3rd in UTEK 2026 by creating a Java application using OOP and the Robots module to locate emergency callers and create efficient routes for ambulance drivers in real-time minimizing time, fuel consumption and maximizing number of patients taken to hospitals in the city of Toronto.

awards.title: Ontario Volunteer Service Award / Distiction pour services Bénévoles
awards.description: The Ontario Volunteer Service Award recognizes volunteers for their continuous commitment and service with one organization. This award highlights five years of volunteering at the We Care For You Charity. The commitment, dedication and selfless service that I have demonstrated has set an example for the next generation of Ontarians.
